column1: # Demo test manifest consumed by scripts/run_demo_tests.sh / run_demo_tests.ps1.
#   demo    directory relative to the repo root (`.` for repo-level scripts)
#           run-probe  -> zanna run <target> with cwd = <demo>; passes only when
#                         the process exits 0 AND prints "RESULT: ok"
#           run-script -> execute <demo>/<target> with cwd = repo root and
#   target  path relative to <demo> (`.` means the demo directory itself)
#   lanes   comma set of: fast, full, perf, requires_display, native-arm64-macos
#           default selection = fast+full; --fast selects fast only; perf rows
#           run only with --perf; requires_display rows are skipped when
#           ZANNA_DEMOS_HEADLESS=1; native-arm64-macos rows run only on
#           macOS arm64 hosts. Rows whose lanes are exactly "quarantine" are
#           never selected: they record known-broken demos pending repair.
#   env     comma-separated KEY=VALUE pairs applied to the child process, or -
# sqldb-basic predates newer BASIC type checking: `zanna check` reports 42
# B2001 errors (operand/array-element type mismatches). Quarantined until the
# dialect port lands; imported verbatim from the zanna repo.
# graphics-show predates the Zanna.Graphics color API rename: `zanna check`
# reports 288 "Undefined identifier: RGB" errors. Quarantined until the API
# port lands; imported verbatim from the zanna repo.
